parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID value is available, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no <props="intl"><ph>**Overview** page or </ph></props>ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: JobId
parameters.description:
The ID of the upgrade batch. This is the **JobId** returned when you invoke [CreateOTAStaticUpgradeJob](~~147496~~) or [CreateOTADynamicUpgradeJob](~~147887~~) to create a batch node.

You can also view the **Batch ID** on the **Update Package Details** page of the over-the-air update package in the IoT Platform console.

parameters.name: TaskId
parameters.description: The ID of the device upgrade task to be re-upgraded. You can specify 1 to 10 **TaskId** values.
